## Activity

North City Eye Clinic completed 467 photographic captures during November 2021. This activity represents the total number of capture episodes recorded at the site for the month. The service continued to provide routine image capture and submitted the recorded examinations for grading.

## Image quality

Of the examinations captured, 7 were assessed as ungradable. This represents an ungradable rate of 1.5 of captures. These examinations could not be used for reliable grading and were recorded separately from examinations that produced an interpretable image. Staff raised no new equipment faults during the month.

## Grading

A total of 85 results were graded as referable. The median lag from capture to grading was 8. This measure provides an indication of the usual time between image capture and completion of grading. The results reported for November 2021 should be considered alongside the image-quality outcome, including the 7 ungradable examinations.
